title: Reply Daily Activity Monitor Configuration
description: Per-user configuration for a Reply Daily Activity Monitor instance. Captured by the /setup wizard. Never share this file publicly - it defines what a specific person watches across M365.

monitor_name.description: Human-friendly name of this monitor instance, e.g. 'AEM/Juliette DAM Monitor'.

owner.description: The person this monitor belongs to. Used only for local headers in generated output.

tenants.description: M365 tenants to sweep. v1 supports one entry (Reply). A second entry (e.g. Valorem) is schema-ready for a future release.

workiq_profile.description: Which WorkIQ MCP sign-in profile to use. Use 'default' unless the recipient has configured named profiles.

seed_terms.description: Curated trigger keywords/phrases. Primary filter across meetings, email, and Teams.

workflow_stages.description: Named end-to-end workflow stages to capture even when no seed term matches (e.g. 'Discovery', 'Design', 'Sign-off').

meetings.description: Meetings to include. Use 'all' to include everything on the owner's calendar/recap surface, or an array of meeting titles / recurring-series identifiers.

people_and_chats.description: User UPNs, group names, or Teams chat IDs to always monitor regardless of seed match.

emails.description: Email scope. Use 'all', 'sent_and_received', or an array of folder names, labels, or sender UPNs.

mode.description: How approved sweeps are delivered. 'local_sync' writes to a local OneDrive/SharePoint-synced folder and relies on the OneDrive client to sync to the cloud (recommended). 'sharepoint_api' uploads via WorkIQ MCP. 'both' does both.

upload_dir.description: Local absolute path where approved sweeps are written. Required when mode is 'local_sync' or 'both'. Typically a OneDrive-synced folder like 'C:/Users/<user>/OneDrive - Reply/<subpath>'.

sharepoint_site_url.description: Root SharePoint site URL. Required when mode is 'sharepoint_api' or 'both'. Example: https://reply.sharepoint.com/sites/DeliveryManagement.

sharepoint_folder_path.description: Server-relative folder inside the site. Required when mode is 'sharepoint_api' or 'both'.

local_staging_dir.description: Local folder for per-run staging output before review.

filename_pattern.description: Basename pattern for generated files (extensions .md/.docx are appended).

cron.description: Cron expression for the daily sweep, e.g. '30 8 * * 1-5' for weekdays at 08:30.

display_time.description: Human-readable rendering of the cron, e.g. 'Weekdays at 8:30 AM America/Chicago'.

required_on_scheduled.description: If true, scheduled runs stop at the review step and require chat approval before SharePoint upload.

required_on_ondemand.description: If true, /sweep runs pause for review before upload.

borderline_policy.description: How to handle single-term or generic-term matches with weak context.

taxonomy_only_matches.description: How to handle items where the seed term appears only as a taxonomy field value (e.g. 'Security' as a category tag).
